newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gas tariffs rise 4.4 percent from Feb 1.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gas tariffs rise 4.4 percent from Feb 1.

text.p: Gas tariffs in Singapore will increase Singapore 0.5 cents (0.35 U.S. cents) per unit from February 1, up 4.4 percent, PowerGas Ltd said on Friday.
PowerGas, a subsidiary of state monopoly Singapore Power, said in a statement the increase was necessary to meet the higher cost of gas production.
The general tariff will rise to 12.23 cents per unit from 11.73 cents.
Bulk tariff A for minimum consumption of 1,000 units per month will increase to 11.23 cents per unit from 10.73 cents.
Bulk tariff B, for minimum consumption of 50,000 units per month, will rise to 10.73 cents per unit against 10.23 cents.
All revised tariffs would apply to the March cycle of meter readings, PowerGas said.
